verdict.rationale: Jev ships official Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs with installable packages, typed clients (sync/async), retry policies, error classes, models listing, and detailed API reference docs, plus a documented agent-skill for coding agents. Community evidence corroborates real API usage (jev-comm-4, jev-comm-6) though with mixed sentiment on value. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of SDK reliability/versioning beyond vendor docs, and confirmation of broader language SDK coverage beyond Python/JS.
